                    ### Question

On further questioning, she revealed that she loves nature and goes on trekking to the woods frequently. She just returned from a similar trip, 2 days ago. On physical examination, a prominent rash along with multiple blisters is noted on the ventral aspect of her right forearm. A photograph of the rash is shown. Which of the following is the most likely reaction that the patient is experiencing?

                    ### Options

opb. Type III hypersensitivity reaction
opc. Bullous pemphigoid
opd. Type I hypersensitivity reaction

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):

The presence of blisters on the ventral aspect of the right forearm is not indicative of Bullous pemphigoid. Evidence supporting mast cell involvement in pruritus and inflammation aligns with the Type I hypersensitivity reaction.
